environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate task (single container, 0.25 vCPU) in an isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer registered as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Consumer access requires VPC endpoint interface creation with explicit principal allowlisting via `AllowedPrincipals` on the endpoint service (only arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root). The NLB target group has a per-target connection cap configured via target group attribute `deregistration_delay.connection_termination.enabled=true` and the Fargate task runs with ECS Service Connect proxy (Envoy) configured with a local rate limit filter: max 1 request per second per downstream connection with `local_rate_limit.max_tokens: 1` and `tokens_per_fill: 1` with `fill_interval: 1s`. Additionally, the task definition sets `cpu=256` (0.25 vCPU) which serializes request handling in the single-threaded event loop of the Envoy sidecar before forwarding to the app container.

config.network: private subnet, no IGW, no NAT gateway
